name: Prickly Pear Margarita
desc: Bright magenta and lightly floral, from prickly pear syrup

ingredients.raw: 2 fluid ounces prickly pear syrup or puree
ingredients.item: fluid ounces prickly pear syrup or puree

ingredients.raw: 1 fluid ounces orange liqueur (Cointreau or triple sec)
ingredients.item: fluid ounces orange liqueur (Cointreau or triple sec)

ingredients.raw: 1 tablespoon kosher salt or Tajin, for the rim
3 lime wedges, for rimming and garnish

steps: Rim the glasses: Spread 1 tablespoon kosher salt or Tajin, for the rim on a small plate. Run a lime wedge from 3 lime wedges, for rimming and garnish around the rim of each glass, then press the rim into the salt. Fill the glasses with fresh ice and set aside.

Build the drink: Fill a cocktail shaker two-thirds with ice. Add 4 fluid ounces blanco tequila, 2 fluid ounces prickly pear syrup or puree, 2 fluid ounces fresh lime juice, and 1 fluid ounces orange liqueur.
Shake: Shake hard until the outside of the shaker is frosted, about 15 seconds .
Strain and serve: Double-strain into the prepared glasses over fresh ice. Garnish with a wedge from 3 lime wedges, for rimming and garnish.
